cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've taken the chair by the door like you. Easy exits. I'll talk about trying again from here.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I moved here because that chair's broken. Are you planning to run?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that one empty, then. Knowing I can go is helping me stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop whenever you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want to come home. But don't hand me a key yet; saying it is enough for tonight.
